rows.claim: The origin brief (watch/ASTRA_ASK_WAR_ROOM_20260909.md loop state) defines the ractor panel as the warm half of a warm/cold validity protocol: five ractors vote APPROVE/AMEND per question, amendments fold, two consecutive APPROVE rounds seal the ask pre-ship, and the contrast class is zero-shared-context cold strangers whose divergence is the finding, harvested under the fold rule quoted below.
rows.steal: One sitting: stamp the next ractor run's template with the two missing job legs, one out-of-cast stranger lane (foreign model family, no estate corpus) and per-lane model+generation stamps, by amending the saved script's ask template and filing the delta note under watch/inbox/gala_20260925/salon-mine/.
rows.falsifier: An in-cast-only ractor run catching a defect class that its same-window out-of-cast stranger control misses would prove the cold leg is not load-bearing and the warm-only design is sufficient, dissolving this law.

rows.claim: A pre-registered kill threshold must be checked against the measured ceiling before registration: ractor-salon-005's stranger computed that cache share 0.9437 leaves 5.63pp of headroom, so the estate's 10pp-over-LRU retirement bar could never fire on that trace and was dead on arrival as a falsifier.
rows.quote: A kill switch that requires the prize to exist before it can fire is not a falsifier; it is a lottery ticket.
rows.steal: One sitting: for the next estate gate with a numeric threshold (census drift 20, ratchet counts, FTS exit rules), compute the measured baseline spread on today's numbers and write a headroom line into the gate's receipt before the threshold is trusted.
rows.falsifier: A threshold set above the measured ceiling that still fires a true positive on the bounded metric would break the headroom arithmetic this law rests on.

rows.claim: Zero-shared-context agreement is not independence when the agreeing seats share tools, laws, and corpus: hash convergence between such workers measures spec-following rather than truth, which is the exact exposure of in-cast ractor panels including ractor50's seven estate-organ lanes.
rows.quote: Zero-shared-context agreement among seats that share tools, laws, and the 1.2M corpus is not independence.
rows.steal: One sitting: when the next convergence claim is filed (blind-worker rebuild, fold agreement, review ACCEPT), record what the agreeing seats share (model family, corpus, tools) next to the claim, and name any validator that read the chain rather than only artifact bytes.
rows.falsifier: A pair of seats sharing tools, laws, and corpus whose hash-converged artifact is later proven correct at the same rate as zero-shared-context pairs would show shared context does not corrupt agreement, dissolving the law's causal reading.

rows.claim: A provenance hash certifies only that a number was not altered after it was written; it says nothing about accuracy-at-write or window representativeness, so every published metric owes three receipts (integrity, accuracy, representativeness) or must be tagged provenance-only.
rows.quote: A hash proves the number was not altered after it was written. It says nothing about whether it was **right when written** (accuracy) or whether the **window was chosen fairly** (representativeness).
rows.steal: One sitting: pick the most recent estate receipt that cites a number with only a sha or hash witness, add the accuracy leg (independent recompute from raw) or relabel the number provenance-only in that receipt's prose.
rows.falsifier: A single case where hash-verification alone, with no recompute and no window check, caught a number that was wrong when written would break the three-receipt separation.

rows.claim: The origin salon's success criterion is pre-ship claim-catching: the same-day fold's verdict line is the ractor job's nameplate, while ractor50's retro shape inherits the harvest (laws, decisions, falsifiers) but not the timing, catching defects after artifacts shipped, with pre-ship power surviving only as accuracy's at-landing resolution gate.
rows.quote: fold caught a bad claim before it shipped. The salon worked.
rows.steal: One sitting: add a pre-ship flaw round to the next workflow's ask template, one lane names the run's own surviving flaw before the receipt publishes, and pin it in the receipt with the lane's name per the origin brief's admission-price clause.
rows.falsifier: A full gala battery where every caught defect was caught post-ship and zero pre-ship flaw rounds fired would confirm the job has drifted to retro-only, making this law a description rather than a standard.
